items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I looked out of the wings and there is Buddy Tate and I said, 'How about getting your horn up,' which he did and came up and played a half hour with me

ctx.x: Wonderful. Do you see anything of Yannick Bruynoghe, you know, Yannick who is the film man and he also wrote that book on Big Bill Broonzy! Do you know who I mean.

I know who you mean. I think I did meet him once in -- I played a -- I did a festival one of the summer festivals in Belgium and a very interesting thing happened. I looked out of the wings and there is Buddy Tate and I said, 'How about getting your horn up,' which he did and came up and played a half hour with me, and it was marvelous. He's a great guy and Buddy comes over quite a lot.
Yes, I know he does, and he's worked a lot with Benny too.
